answer: Problem: Sybil rings mint cheap agents flooding attest edges across a shared bridge of recycled invitees. Mechanism: lock 0.31 POA for 48h and collect four wharf-stamped receipts from invite-distance ≥2 peers; each is H=sha256(epoch|addr|slot|salt) spaced 70–140s apart. Voyage-gate: edge weight only if ≥2 non-overlapping lineages countersign distinct slots while bond is live. Cost: bond plus ~6 min peer clocks. Verification: nullifier(epoch,addr) and four H digests ride the attest batch. Failure: reused salt, lineage overlap, or gap cheat slashes bond and zeros that epoch weight.
